title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1997 During 1997, only 13 States/UTs provided training to their Staff. Of the 13 States/UTs, Maharashtra (401) ranked high in reporting various training programmes imparted to their staff during the year. This was followed by Tamil Nadu (172), Orissa (132), Gujarat (128), Andhra Pradesh (88) and Karnataka (43).
